p: Drayton Manor sits in a handy spot in south Staffordshire, close to the border with Warwickshire and the West Midlands, so there's lots within a short drive if you're making a weekend of it.

Lichfield is just a few miles to the north-west, and its cathedral is the only medieval English cathedral with three spires, known locally as the Ladies of the Vale. The city centre is small, walkable and full of cafés, and the birthplace of Dr Samuel Johnson, the dictionary writer, is now a museum on the market square.

For something gentler for little ones, Ash End House Children's Farm near Middleton is a friendly farm with animals to feed and play areas, a perfect follow-on from the zoo for toddlers. Kingsbury Water Park, a short way south, has lakes, trails and play spaces that are lovely for a picnic and a scooter ride.

At the resort, it's worth knowing that the zoo can be quiet first thing while everyone races to the rides, so early birds get a peaceful start. The site is flat and buggy-friendly. If you've got a mix of ages, splitting up for an hour is easy: thrill-seekers head for the big rides while the younger ones spend time with the animals, then meet for lunch.
